title: Da Lat in a day
summary: A walk from Xuan Huong Lake to the market, the cathedral, the DALAT station, and back to Lam Vien Square after dark.

stops.name: Xuan Huong Lake
stops.note: Start on the shore while the mist is still on the water.

stops.name: Da Lat Market
stops.note: Strawberries and avocado ice cream on the slope above the lake.

stops.name: Da Lat Cathedral
stops.note: The tower on Tran Phu. It is not the pink church at Domaine de Marie.

stops.name: Da Lat Railway Station
stops.note: The facade with DALAT on it. Add the Trai Mat train only if Linh Phuoc is the rest of the day.

stops.name: Lam Vien Square
stops.note: Back to the lake edge after dark. The night market is the slope above.

seoDescription: A one-day Da Lat walk: Xuan Huong Lake, the market, the cathedral, and the DALAT station.
